WEALE’S SERIES

body.p: “It is not too much to say that no books have ever proved more popular with or more useful to young engineers and others than the excellent treatises comprised in Weale’s Series.”—Engineer.

CROSBY LOCKWOOD AND SON,
7, STATIONERS’ HALL COURT, LONDON, E.C.
1900.
